youtube_short.title: The $1,400 Hidden Mortgage Fee Nobody Explains
title_alternatives: PMI: The Fee That Protects Your Bank, Not You
Why Most Homeowners Waste $1,400 Every Year
youtube_short.description: PMI — Private Mortgage Insurance — is one of the sneakiest fees hiding in millions of mortgage payments, and it protects your bank, not you. The average homeowner pays it for 7+ years, racking up over $8,400. Here's the thing: once you hit 80% loan-to-value, your lender is legally required to remove it when you ask — but they'll never bring it up first. Pull up your mortgage statement, calculate your LTV, and if you're near 80% write that letter today. It takes five minutes and costs nothing. #PMI #mortgage #personalfinance #homeowner #moneytips

hook_line: Your mortgage hides a $1,400/yr fee that protects your bank — not you
